title: Killing of Thule Society members, April 1919

tellings.quote: an assassination of members of the Tula Gazelle shaft uh on April 30th in 1919.

plain: Members of the Thule Society, a secretive nationalist group in Munich, were assassinated on 30 April 1919, according to a researcher named Peter Levenda. He mentions it in passing while talking with Michels and does not name a source, and he gives no more detail about who died or why.
